Provides IPv4/IPv6 networking, TCP/UDP sockets, ARP, ICMP, and DHCP services.

Typen — Übersicht

  • struct TcpIp_ConfigType Configuration data structure of the Tcp Ip module.
  • TcpIp_DomainType Tcp Ip address families.
  • TcpIp_ProtocolType Protocol type used by a socket.
  • struct TcpIp_SockAddrType Generic structure used by APIs to specify an IP address.
  • struct TcpIp_SockAddrInetType This structure defines an IPv4 address type which can be derived from the generic address structure via cast.
  • struct TcpIp_SockAddrInet6Type This structure defines a IPv6 address type which can be derived from the generic address structure via cast.
  • TcpIp_LocalAddrIdType Address identification type for unique identification of a local IP address and Eth If Controller configured in the Tcp Ip module.
  • TcpIp_SocketIdType Socket identifier type for unique identification of a Tcp Ip stack socket.
  • enum TcpIp_StateType Specifies the Tcp Ip state for a specific Eth If controller.
  • enum TcpIp_IpAddrStateType Specifies the state of local IP a ddress assignment
  • TcpIp_EventType Events reported by Tcp Ip.
  • TcpIp_IpAddrAssignmentType IPv6 address assignment policy.
  • enum TcpIp_ReturnType Tcp Ip specific return type.
  • TcpIp_ParamIdType Type TcpIp_ParamIdType.
  • TcpIpIpAddrWildcardType IP address wildcard.
  • TcpIpIp6AddrWildcardType IP6 address wildcard.
  • TcpIpPortWildcardType Port wildcard.
  • TcpIpLocalAddrIdWildcardType Local Addr Id wildcard.
  • TcpIp_ArpCacheEntryType Tcp Ip_ Arp Cache Entries elements type
  • TcpIp_NdpCacheEntryType Tcp Ip_ Ndp Cache Entries elements type
  • TcpIp_MeasurementIdxType Index to select specific measurement data
  • TcpIp_TlsConnectionIdType TLS connection identifier type for unique identification of a TLS connection.

function [SWS_TCPIP_00226] 📄 PDF
Std_ReturnType <<<<>>>> (TcpIp_SocketIdType SocketId, TcpIp_SocketIdType SocketId Connected, const TcpIp_SockAddrType* Remote AddrPtr);

This service gets called if the stack put a socket into the listen mode before (as server) and a peer connected to it (as client). In detail: T he TCP/ IP stack calls this function after a socket was set into the listen state with Tcp Ip_ Tcp Listen() and a TCP connection is requested by the peer.
function [SWS_TCPIP_00227] 📄 PDF
void <<<<>>>> (TcpIp_SocketIdType SocketId);

This service gets called if the stack initiated a TCP connection before (as client) and the peer (the server) acknowledged the connection set up. In detail: The TCP/ IP stack calls this function after a socket was requested to connect with Tcp Ip_ Tcp Conn ect() and a TCP connection is confirmed by the peer. The parameter value of Socket Id equals the Socket Id value of the preceeding Tcp Ip_ Tcp Connect() call.
